objective: Test whether explicit local graph frames and target-derived local cross-section anatomy explain held-out real cave shape, and whether a learned residual adds value beyond an anisotropic procedural sweep.

hypotheses.h1_frame: Nearest-graph tangent and linearity improve geometry-only graph-field decoding over CW0 distance and density features.
hypotheses.h2_representation: Local directional void extents and route clearance make an anisotropic graph sweep substantially closer to measured cave morphology than a single-radius sweep.
hypotheses.h3_learning: A compact residual MLP conditioned on local anatomy improves the anisotropic sweep without losing patch-specific equal-volume shape.

representations.geometry_features: ten frozen CW0 graph-relative features plus nearest-graph tangent YZX and local linearity
local_anatomy_features: negative and positive void extent along gravity-frame Y, Z, and X
route clearance in normalized SDF training units
local void fraction at five- and nine-voxel windows
local observation fraction at a five-voxel window
representations.oracle_warning: All local anatomy features are derived from held-out target geometry at graph voxels. They test representational sufficiency only and are forbidden as a deployable or generative claim.
representations.runtime_contract: A later anatomy generator, geological simulator, or user control must predict or specify these local attributes without target access.

training.sign_balance: inverse-frequency within each sampled training patch, clipped to [0.5, 4.0]
training.evaluation_queries: all 32x32x32 voxels for every held-out patch

gates.h1_frame: geometry-frame MLP beats the single-radius sweep by the registered three-of-four morphology and negative-mean-log rule on at least 3 of 5 folds
gates.h2_representation: anisotropic local-anatomy sweep beats the single-radius sweep by the morphology rule on at least 4 of 5 folds, improves absolute log median volume error on at least 4 folds, and its mean equal-volume IoU is no more than 0.02 below the radial baseline
gates.h3_learning: local-anatomy residual MLP beats the anisotropic sweep by the morphology rule on at least 3 of 5 folds and its mean equal-volume IoU is no more than 0.02 below the anisotropic sweep
gates.safety: all projected outputs retain 100 percent of protected route voxels and all fields are finite
gates.visual: only after automated adjudication, render the same deterministic median-volume held-out patch per cave at raw zero threshold and equal target volume

decision_policy.h2_pass_h3_fail: promote local anatomy representation with procedural anisotropic base; reserve learning for later sparse geological refinement
decision_policy.h2_pass_h3_pass: promote local anatomy representation and graph-neighborhood learned field to CW1
decision_policy.h2_fail: reject target local-axis extents as insufficient; stop graph-field learning and use a richer chamber/cross-section asset representation
decision_policy.h1_only: insufficient for promotion because geometry alone still lacks explicit anatomy
